vis.scope: One MeasurementSet; lists with more than one MS are refused (#54/#980).

selectdata.scope: Read then ignored; CASA task selection fields are applied regardless of this flag.

field.scope: IDs and inclusive ranges, exact FIELD names and simple * patterns, including mixed lists, resolve natively from metadata once per survey. Name matching trims stored names and skips flagged FIELD entries; each missing name is an error, including in a mixed list. FIELD CODE/numeric-name fallback, quoted/regex/comparison/extended-glob expressions and full numeric-ID validation remain unfinished.

spw.scope: Copied as spectral-window/channel selector; selected-channel derived cube extents are refused in limited nchan/start/width cases (issue 980).

timerange.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

uvrange.scope: Copied as CASA selector text to request.

antenna.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

scan.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

observation.scope: Read and ignored at default; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

intent.scope: Copied as CASA selector text to request.

datacolumn.scope: data/observed maps to DATA; corrected maps to automatic CORRECTED_DATA else DATA; other strings refused.

imagename.scope: Fresh namespaces for supported imaging; default continuation reuses same-grid raw model and binary CLEAN mask for standard unfaceted single-term Stokes-I MFS with no new explicit mask. Owner-approved contract32 enables fresh single-main restart=False numbering, including relative/absolute paths. All20 small public CLI/Python product/preservation rows pass; one scalar output has identity-bound owner acceptance. Outlier/orphan namespaces and broader persistence remain unfinished (#944).

imsize.scope: Positive even scalar/one/two dimensions; non-square standard/W/mosaic is implemented (#970). Odd dimensions are refused; AW requires square images and equal cells.

cell.scope: Scalar/one/two quantities or numeric arcseconds; empty is refused as in CASA. Unequal axes are implemented outside AW (#970).

phasecenter.scope: Numeric text is split into phasecenter_field; other text becomes phasecenter direction; empty means unset.

stokes.scope: Native Stokes/correlation coordinates; full-Stokes and basis-dependent combinations require their own acceptance, not an I-plane inference.

projection.scope: Read and ignored; non-default is catalog-refused (issue 980).

startmodel.scope: One string path to a real Jy/pixel model, MFS or cube, with compatible spectral axes and direction frame. Equal-count Stokes planes are copied positionally, warning when labels differ (owner decision 2026-10-31). A single Q-to-I seed is CASA-paired verified; permuted multi-plane copying has focused native tests only and unequal plane counts remain unassessed. Masked pixels become zero; linear flux-preserving reprojection. MT-MFS and outlier combinations remain refused. Singleton-list input [path] is refused by the existing Path catalog, despite CASA accepting that form; this remains an unfinished input-domain gap. Shared frozen string seeds are paired in the numbering activation wave.

specmode.scope: cont aliases mfs; mvc is refused (issue 823); cube, cubedata and cubesource pass into request/spectral compile.

reffreq.scope: Read and ignored by reader; catalog refuses non-default in every mode (issue 980).

nchan.scope: In cube, positive value supplies output count; -1 uses casa-rs channel_count. MFS ignores this count. Derived CASA extent cases are refused (issue 980).

start.scope: MFS ignores it; cube copies text. A channel-subset spw without explicit start is refused; some nchan=-1 derived extents are refused (issue 980).

width.scope: MFS ignores it; cube copies text. Some nchan=-1 derived extents are refused (issue 980).

outframe.scope: MFS only accepts CASA default LSRK; cube accepts LSRK/BARY/TOPO/REST case-insensitively and uppercases; other frames refused (issue 980).

veltype.scope: MFS ignores it; cube maps radio->RADIO, optical/z->OPTICAL, beta/relativistic/true->BETA; other values refused (issue 980).

restfreq.scope: Explicit MFS restfreq still requires empty; cube accepts zero or one frequency. The ordinary empty MFS default now reads SOURCE metadata using first selected SPW and CASA-VI field ordering; DOPPLER-backed lookup and multiple SOURCE key groups with stored wildcards explicitly refuse as unfinished (#980).

interpolation.scope: MFS ignores it; cube forwards it except cubic, which is refused (issue 823).

gridder.scope: Aliases standard/ft/gridft, W aliases, and mosaic aliases normalize; awproject accepted; awprojectft and other unsupported families refused (issue 980).

facets.scope: Standard gridder passes count; mosaic rejects count != 1 as CASA does; W/AW count != 1 refused pending support (issue 980).

psfphasecenter.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for mosaic/mosaicft/ftmosaic (issue 980).

wprojplanes.scope: W/AW: -1 becomes derive/None and positive counts pass; non-positive other than -1 refused. W aliases with one plane normalize to standard. Ignored by other gridders.

vptable.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for listed non-AW gridder families (issue 980).

mosweight.scope: True with density weighting and gridder exactly mosaic is refused (issue 818); otherwise not mapped into request.

aterm.scope: Read; AW requires true, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

psterm.scope: Read; AW requires false, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

wbawp.scope: Read; AW requires true, otherwise ignored; incompatible AW value refused (issue 980).

conjbeams.scope: Read; AW requires true and mosaic requires false; other gridders ignore it; incompatible values refused (issue 980).

cfcache.scope: AW with default CASA-import cache requires non-empty path and passes it; otherwise ignored.

usepointing.scope: Copied only for mosaic/AW; read and ignored for standard/W.

computepastep.scope: Read and ignored; non-default values catalog-refused for applicable AW families (issue 980).

rotatepastep.scope: Read and ignored; non-default values catalog-refused for applicable AW families (issue 980).

pointingoffsetsigdev.scope: Scalar/list numbers converted to comma text for AW; otherwise ignored.

pblimit.scope: Copied; request requires non-zero magnitude below 1.

normtype.scope: Passed only to mosaic/AW; pbsquare refused (issue 823); other gridders ignore it.

deconvolver.scope: hogbom/clark/multiscale/mtmfs pass; asp refused with issue 223; other CASA algorithms refused with issue 823.

scales.scope: Number list; forwarded only for multiscale/mtmfs, otherwise normalized to none; request disallows negative scales.

nterms.scope: Used only by mtmfs; other deconvolvers force one. mtmfs nterms=1 refused (issue 980); request enforces >1 exactly for mtmfs.

fusedthreshold.scope: Ignored outside ASP, as CASA ignores it. ASP is refused (#223); no ASP implementation is claimed.

largestscale.scope: Ignored outside ASP, as CASA ignores it. ASP is refused (#223); no ASP implementation is claimed.

restoringbeam.scope: Empty -> none; common -> common; explicit axes/angle form refused pending support (issue 980).

pbcor.scope: Copied; determines primary-beam-corrected product/beam behavior downstream.

outlierfile.scope: Native outlier fields, natural weighting, dirty or Hogbom; each outlier currently has standard single-term MFS defaults. Per-field differing modes, start models and spectral controls are restricted by the existing parser.

weighting.scope: natural/uniform/briggs/briggsbwtaper accepted; unsupported weighting modes refused (issue 980); briggsbwtaper with MFS refused as CASA does. Cube Briggs per-channel density follows BriggsCubeWeightor's cell orientation (negated u and v).

noise.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused when weighting=briggsabs (issue 980); briggsabs itself is not implemented.

npixels.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused for non-natural weighting (issue 980).

uvtaper.scope: Unit-bearing circular/elliptical angles or lambda/klambda; one/two/three entries. Missing-unit values are refused instead of reproducing CASA's radians-versus-documented-lambda behavior (#970).

niter.scope: Copied to the total reported minor-cycle iteration limit. Owner-approved contract31 defaults the native extra Hogbom accounting mode to casa-inclusive, matching CASA's extra physical component at a positive cycle limit. Explicit strict remains available; scientific verification is recorded separately.

threshold.scope: Copied; request interprets quantity in Jy/beam; return record echoes original number/text for dirty runs.

cycleniter.scope: CASA correction: <=0 or >niter becomes niter (at least 1); maps to minor_cycle_length.

interactive.scope: Read and ignored by request; non-default catalog-refused (issue 980), since interactive viewer path is unsupported.

nmajor.scope: -1 means unlimited; zero performs only the initial residual/major pass; positive limits count subsequent major passes. Existing controller gives global-threshold and zero-mask stops precedence.20 small standard Stokes-I MFS CLI/Python pairs verify products and exact iteration/major/stop counts; other mode combinations and full return parity are separate behavioral obligations.
nmajor.mapping: nmajor -> ReconstructionControls.maximum_major_cycles (-1 -> None; otherwise Some(limit)); reported nmajordone includes the initial pass.

fullsummary.scope: Long-form keys exist, but missing measurements and per-plane values are NaN. Return shape alone is not return-value equivalence.

usemask.scope: user and auto-multithresh pass; pb refused (issue 823); controls whether user mask is read.

mask.scope: One mask image or signed integer CRTF pixel boxes, inline or in a region file. Bounds clip to the image and outside/empty-region unions mean zero support, not full-plane support.38 small paired rows pass across CPU64/CPU32/Metal32 and public Python; explicit empty-file + fresh numbering preserves old products and adds no components. Absent masks still permit normal cleaning. Fractional/world/general CRTF, multiple images, new masks on occupied default-restart outputs and broader mask/mode combinations remain unfinished.

noisethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

lownoisethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

negativethreshold.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

minbeamfrac.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

cutthreshold.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

growiterations.scope: Copied as auto-multithresh parameters; presence is still read even outside that mode.

dogrowprune.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

minpercentchange.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

verbose.scope: Read and ignored; non-default catalog-refused only with usemask=auto-multithresh (issue 980).

restart.scope: True continues bounded same-grid standard unfaceted single-term Stokes-I MFS using raw model and binary CLEAN mask. False is active in owner-approved contract32: a single main image starts fresh at the highest recognized numbered suffix plus1, preserving old files. All20 small public CLI/Python product/naming/preservation rows pass;19/20 selected scalar rows pass raw limits and one exact Metal output is owner-accepted by identity-bound review. behaviors.title: Selection and multi-MS inputs
behaviors.scope: vis, field, spw, timerange, uvrange, antenna, scan, observation, intent, datacolumn and selectdata (#54).
behaviors.gap: IDs/ranges, names/simple patterns, mixed field lists, SPW/channel text, intent and UV limits are routed natively. Sixteen field cases compare exact physical MAIN row order or refusal with CASA, including flagged and padded FIELD metadata. Since the main imaging cutover was integrated (3016f1b), FIELD selection resolves over the observation catalogue's FIELD rows on MSv2 and MSv4 alike; on the production traversal the field cases of the CASA row oracle (IDs, names, glob, mixed, range) and both refusals read exactly CASA's physical MAIN rows. Production T1 compares ID/name selections with selectdata=False on the single native route. The unactivated scan/observation preview is re-expressed on that path (scan 1, scan 3 and observation 0 match CASA's rows) but remains catalog-refused. CODE/numeric-name fallback, advanced field forms, multi-MS and four row selectors remain unfinished/refused. Image-science comparisons for selected real datasets, flags, channel membership and data-column fallback remain separate required evidence.

Embedded model/mask pixel masks, tabulated spectral grids, new explicit/auto masks on occupied outputs, broader modes/outliers and false calc controls remain unfinished; concurrency at one prefix unassessed. behaviors.title: Cube axes, reference frequencies and moving sources
behaviors.scope: specmode, spw, start, width, nchan, reffreq, restfreq, outframe, veltype, interpolation and perchanweightdensity.
behaviors.gap: Cube channel-count mapping exists, but selected-channel-derived defaults are refused; MFS frame/rest-frequency forms, multiple rest frequencies and cubic interpolation remain restricted. Moving-source cubesource needs its own representative oracle (#714). MVC removal is a separate prior owner decision, not a passing moving-source comparison. The moving-MFS spectral envelope now uses CASA FIELD-origin direction semantics; six fixed/moving CPU64/CPU32/GPU32 comparisons pass recorded WCS values, and the previous 3.5 Hz increment mismatch is repaired at its unchanged tolerance. This does not complete moving-PB or cubesource acceptance. The ordinary MFS default SOURCE rest-frequency label is now repaired; five fresh mosaic/AW weight families and small restart metadata checks match. The MFS header's first visibility field is the least (DATA_DESC_ID, FIELD_ID) of the selected samples; CASA sorts ARRAY_ID first, which neither store's partitions carry, so a selection spanning several arrays may name another field (unfinished, not an accepted deviation).

behaviors.title: Gridder, weighting and beam combinations
behaviors.scope: standard/W/mosaic/AW, rectangular geometry, facets, normtype, beam terms and density weighting.
behaviors.gap: Rectangular standard/W/mosaic and uvtaper were implemented in #970. AW remains square/equal-cell, MFS-only, with fixed A/WB/conjugate terms and no PS term. Mosaic per-field density weighting is refused (#818); W/AW facets and additional gridders/weightings remain incomplete. Native CF generation is verified separately from CASA cache oracles. The native write_pb default is True. Homogeneous ALMA-labelled 7m arrays select ACA; legacy VLA PB now covers all named bands and NVSS frequency gaps. Fresh ordinary-default W/Hogbom20 CPU64/CPU32 runs pass all seven products, with PB NRMS zero. Moving/nonconstant FIELD directions, mixed dish classes, unsupported telescopes and remaining EVLA bands are unfinished. Explicit GPU W/AW remains refused. CASA Float channel-frequency narrowing is now matched in shared Taylor factors. All five fresh mosaic/native-AW MT-MFS rows pass the owner-approved scoped weak weight.tt1 rule and retained original recorded checks; 3 override only raw weight.tt1 relative-error failures. Exact guards and 1e-6 matrix-scale limits remain. Full metadata is separate. Existing #690 odd-sumwt scaling remains distinct. Legacy VLA cube PB takes CASA's channel-zero aperture scaled per channel: both T1.5 VLA cube rows give .pb NRMS 0.0 at 9768bb1, 3016f1b and 2628d8b (pre-candidate 0.0136); independent review pending. Cube Briggs density cells now use CASA's negated u and v (2628d8b): all 3,056,967 point-cube-briggs (row, channel) weights match CASA's to 1.35e-7, where 7 exact Float ties previously read a neighbouring cell.

decisions.inputs: Any occupied main/outlier image namespace; restart=False or recalculation controls.
decisions.casa: Continues existing products by default, or chooses a numbered fresh prefix with restart=False.
decisions.ours: Bounded same-grid standard Stokes-I MFS default continuation now has native gates, small paired CASA 10->0->10/mask evidence and both-direction continuation. Contract32 activates single-main fresh numbering; small public products/preservation pass. Other occupied namespaces, coordinated outlier/orphan numbering and calc flags remain unfinished.
decisions.rationale: Reuse the existing native model/mask lifecycle with admitted ownership, preserving unsupported-state refusals while completing parity.
decisions.impact: The bounded native default path can continue prior work; unsupported modes and flags still require completion and are not agreed exclusions.

decisions.casa: Interprets bare values as radians, despite documenting lambda; large values may zero every imaging weight.
decisions.ours: Requires explicit angle or lambda/klambda units and errors clearly on bare values.
decisions.rationale: Prevent a documented-unit mismatch from silently producing an empty image.
decisions.impact: Callers must supply units; numerical unit-bearing taper behavior remains governed by #970 evidence.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner, 2026-10-31, this chat: Require explicit units.

decisions.inputs: Start-model Stokes labels differ from the target; equal plane counts.
decisions.casa: Copies planes by position without converting polarization, since only direction and spectral axes are regridded.

decisions.rationale: Match CASA's behavior, while making the label mismatch visible.
decisions.impact: A Q model can seed I and permuted Stokes planes are copied positionally; this is not a physical polarization conversion. Unequal-plane-count behavior still needs oracle assessment.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner, 2026-10-31, this chat: Match but issue a warning. This supersedes the prior refusal.

decisions.inputs: Two-term Stokes-I MFS mosaic/AW weight.tt1; both reference weak-coupling measures<=1e-3, with all reviewed accumulator guards.
decisions.casa: An almost cancelling odd weight term makes error relative to its own near-zero norm unstable; exact CASA product values remain the oracle.
